Header.Name: Polity
Header.Description: To enter the Polities and time durations.

Component.name: Polity
Component.Documentation: A sovereign polity with governance authority. Historical entities modeled as they existed at their time. For 16th-19th century context, includes composite monarchies, republics, empires, and chartered companies with sovereign powers. Modeled as a subclass of E74 Group because polities are collective entities whose members are subjects/citizens. This enables uniform treatment of political membership via hasNationality (subPropertyOf P107i_is_current_or_former_member_of).

Element.name: fullName
Element.Documentation: For persons, it maps to: https://w3id.org/pnv#literalName

Component.name: Identifiers
Component.Documentation: Internal note: for Letters (profile v2), the URI should be mapped to: https://lod.academy/cer/vocab/ontology#21_Identifier. CIDOC path: ->P1->E42[1_1]->P190->rdf:Literal.

Element.name: identifierType
Element.Documentation: The type/scheme of identifier (e.g., "Wikidata QID", "VIAF", "project local"

Element.name: identifierValue
Element.Documentation: Add the identifier's label (e.g., the shelfmark, or the identifier number in another scheme). If you chose "Other" in the Identifier type, enter here in parenthesis where the identifier comes from, for example: N011111 (Nodegoat).

Element.name: identifierUri
Element.Documentation: Persistent identifier (optional): If the object has a permanent identifier (e.g., a URN, DOI, or handle), enter the full IRI here (e.g., https://resolver.staatsbibliothek-berlin.de/SBB00019E8400000003). It does not need to be resolvable. If it is OpenStreetMaps: Enter the URI from OpenStreetMap API. You can search directly in OpenStreetMaps and paste the URI here. The URI has to have this format, for example: https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/214885 (note the type in the middle: relation, node, way)

Element.name: datePrecision
Element.Documentation: This helps validate that dateStart/dateEnd are filled correctly.

Element.name: dateStart
Element.Documentation: Enter earliest possible date in EDTF format. Rules: 1) For an EXACT date: enter the date in dateStart, leave dateEnd empty. 2) For a RANGE: enter earliest in dateStart, latest in dateEnd. 3) For "BEFORE X": leave dateStart empty, enter X in dateEnd. 4) For "AFTER Y": enter Y in dateStart, leave dateEnd empty. 5) EDTF uncertainty markers (?, ~, %) can be used in either field, follow the instructions here: https://knaw.sharepoint.com/:w:/s/PRJ-Brievenportaal/IQB7jUVOq98BR4Oy786Ch8n1AcilMidno3GLLVdmgUaYF-8?e=FBjVTA

Element.name: dateEnd
Element.Documentation: Enter latest possible date in EDTF format. See rules in documentation of field "dateStart", . For EDTF conventions, follow the instructions here: https://knaw.sharepoint.com/:w:/s/PRJ-Brievenportaal/IQB7jUVOq98BR4Oy786Ch8n1AcilMidno3GLLVdmgUaYF-8?e=FBjVTA

Element.name: noteDate
Element.Documentation: Add any clarifying notes related to the dates. These notes may be for internal or external use (t.b.d.)

Element.name: confidenceValue
Element.Documentation: How confident you (or an algorithm) are of an observation (what you observed (read) in the source), or of a reconstruction. Reflect the uncertainties and ambiguities of the inferred observation (or reconstruction) by choosing one of the values.

Component.Documentation: Explained in the project documentation (add link:...)

Element.name: recordStatus
Element.Documentation: To indicate the stage the record is at in terms of completeness. For example, for a Source: all relevant data has been extracted from the source, or if there is still data that could be extracted at a later stage. For an Entity observation: if it is an initial draft, or if all the observation-related data is entered.

item.AppInfo: Use for sources which are not yet analized, no data is extracted
Use for Entities (e.g., Actor) which are created quickly but no data is yet extracted
Use for Sources or Entities for which some data has been extracted, but there are still other pieces of data to be extracted
all relevant data from this Source or Entity has been extracted

Element.name: noteType
Element.Documentation: Add any specific types of notes to the controlled vocabulary.
